name: AI Generator
author: story321

sections.description:
AI Generator is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that leverages artificial intelligence to generate high-quality content, including articles and images, directly within your WordPress environment. It supports multiple languages and offers real-time generation feedback.

Key Features:

  • AI Article Generation: Generate high-quality article content based on prompts.
  • AI Image Generation: Create relevant images from text descriptions.
  • Multiple Languages Support: Supports 20+ languages, including Chinese and English.
  • Real-time Generation: View generation results in real-time.
  • Editor Integration: Seamless integration with the WordPress editor for one-click content insertion.
  • Points System: Built-in dual system with member points and regular points.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. Story321 Authentication Service

    • Service Purpose: Used for user authentication and obtaining API access tokens
    • Data Sent: User email and password (only when logging in and automatically logging in)
    • Data Receiver: https://story321.com/wp-json/jwt-auth/v1/token
    • Service Provider: Story321.com
    • Service Terms: https://story321.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://story321.com/privacy-policy/

  2. AI Text Generation Service

    • Service Purpose: Used to generate AI text content
    • Data Sent: User prompt and authentication token (each time content is generated)
    • Data Receiver: https://studio.story321.com/api/tm/generate-text
    • Service Provider: Story321.com
    • Service Terms: https://story321.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://story321.com/privacy-policy/

  3. AI Image Generation Service

    • Service Purpose: Used to generate AI image content
    • Data Sent: User prompt and authentication token (each time an image is generated)
    • Data Receiver: https://studio.story321.com/api/tm/generate-text2image
    • Service Provider: Story321.com
    • Service Terms: https://story321.com/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://story321.com/privacy-policy/

Using this plugin means you agree to the transmission and processing of this data. If you do not wish to send data to these external services, please do not use this plugin.

Usage

  1. After activation, you’ll find the “AI Generator” meta box in the post editor.
  2. Select the generation type (Article/Image).
  3. Enter your prompts in the provided field.
  4. Click the generate button.
  5. Wait for the content generation to complete.
  6. The generated content will be automatically inserted into the editor.

Settings

  1. Navigate to “AI Generator Settings” in the WordPress admin settings page.
  2. Enter your Story321 account email and password to log in.
  3. Check your remaining points after logging in.
  4. Purchase additional points through the Story321 official website.

Support

If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact us through:

  • Website: https://story321.com
  • Email: support@story321.com

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please submit pull requests to our GitHub repository: [Your GitHub Repository URL]

License

AI Generator is licensed under the GPLv3 open source license.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin package.
  2. In your WordPress admin panel, navigate to “Plugins” -> “Add New”.
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and upload the downloaded plugin package.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Why did generation fail?

Please check the following:
1. Ensure that your Story321 account is logged in correctly.
2. Verify that you have sufficient points for content generation.
3. Check your network connection to ensure it is stable.

Which languages are supported?

Currently, the plugin supports 20+ languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
